content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Sheikhpura Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Sheikhpura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the DCPU Sheikhpura Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the DCPU Sheikhpura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the posts of Nurse, Doctor (Part Time), Ayah, and Chowkidar in the DCPU Sheikhpura Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the DCPU Sheikhpura posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years for all posts in the DCPU Sheikhpura Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Nurse post?
faq.answer: For the Nurse post, candidates must have completed Intermediate with G.N.M or a Bachelor's degree in Nursing from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for DCPU Sheikhpura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the posts in DCPU Sheikhpura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 7944 to Rs. 11916 per month, depending on the post applied for.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for the DCPU Sheikhpura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DCPU Sheikhpura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Interview, Document Verification, and the final Merit List.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for candidates in DCPU Sheikhpura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is available for in-service candidates as per the prevailing government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q10. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the District Child Protection Unit Sheikhpura (DCPU Sheikhpura).
